options.name: Resolution:
options.description:
Refers to the level of screen definition in pixels,
a higher resolution may result in poorer performance

options.name: Anti-Aliasing
options.description:
If unchecked, disables anti-aliasing, increases performance
at the cost of sharper visuals.

options.name: Low Detail
options.description:
If checked, disables some background details,
decreases loading times and improves performance.

options.name: Subtitles
options.description: If checked, subtitles will show in cutscenes

options.name: Downscroll
options.description: If checked, notes go Down instead of Up, simple enough.

options.name: Middlescroll
options.description: If checked, your notes get centered.

options.name: Ghost Tapping
options.description:
If checked, you won't get misses from pressing keys
while there are no notes able to be hit.

options.name: Note Quantization
options.description:
If checked, the note colors will depend on
their beat quantization instead of their direction.
(Highly recommended)

options.name: Flashing Lights
options.description: Uncheck this if you're sensitive to flashing lights!

options.name: Note Splashes
options.description: If unchecked, hitting "Sick!" notes won't show particles.

options.name: Camera Zooms
options.description: If unchecked, the camera won't zoom in on a beat hit.

options.name: Dynamic Camera
options.description: If checked, the camera will move in the note direction.

options.name: Hide HUD
options.description: If checked, hides most HUD elements.

options.name: Hide Song Length
options.description:
If checked, the bar showing how much time is left
will be hidden.

cutscene:
It was a quiet night, 
and Boyfriend and Girlfriend 
were on a date... 
on top of a building.

Since they have 1 neuron 
and share it in turns, 
they fell off the building, landing on a 
dumpster that broke their fall.

Girlfriend, upon falling 
into the trash, finds a notebook, 
with several pages torn out 
and full of erasures.

Dizzy from the fall, 
she accidentally uses her powers, 
entering the notebook with BF on 
the only sheet that was almost intact.
